primary_service.name: ZSUPPLIERPAYMENTBLOCK_0001
primary_service.purpose: Direct lookup of supplier/vendor payment block status and reason

sample_query_params.invoice_doc_number: optional, if ticket references a specific invoice

supporting_services.name: ZC_MNTRDOCWTHGRIRFLAGNOTSET_CDS_0001
supporting_services.purpose: Check GR/IR mismatch as a root cause for the block

supporting_services.name: ZFAC_GRIR_RECONCILIATION_SRV_0001
supporting_services.purpose: GR/IR reconciliation detail, if root cause is clearing-related

diagnosis_logic: 1. Query ZSUPPLIERPAYMENTBLOCK_0001 for the vendor/invoice -> get block reason code.
2. If block reason indicates price/qty/GR mismatch -> query ZC_MNTRDOCWTHGRIRFLAGNOTSET_CDS_0001 for GR/IR detail.
3. If block reason is manual/payment block (Zahlungssperre) -> check ZFAP_VENDOR_BALANCE_SRV_0001 for related open items.
4. Draft: block reason + likely cause + recommended action (release block / post GR / adjust qty).
use_cases.notes: Highest-confidence starting use case: exact-name service match to the ticket type. No RFC fallback expected to be needed for v1.

use_cases.ticket_category: Purchase Order stuck / not releasing / status check

primary_service.name: ZMM_PUR_POITEMS_MONI_SRV_0001
primary_service.purpose: PO item-level monitoring: status, quantities, flags

supporting_services.name: ZMM_PUR_PO_MAINT_V2_SRV_0001
supporting_services.purpose: PO maintain (release strategy fields, if exposed as read)

supporting_services.name: ZAPI_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV_0001
supporting_services.purpose: Standard-style PO process API, fallback if Fiori-bound services are awkward via MCP

fallback_rfc_bapi.note: Use only if none of the OData candidates above return release strategy / approver info cleanly.

diagnosis_logic: 2. If release-strategy info not present, query ZC_PURCHASEORDER_FS_SRV_0001 or ZPO_DISPLAY_DETAILS_SRV_0001 for header detail.
3. If still missing release code/approver, fall back to BAPI_PO_GETRELINFO via RFC.
4. Draft: current release status, pending approver/level, and likely reason (e.g. value threshold, missing account assignment).
use_cases.notes: Multiple overlapping OData candidates -- test each against a real MCP call first, pick the cleanest response shape, then drop the rest from the map to keep it simple.
